title: Ayo Ahmed — Independent concept for Trybe

scenes.narration: I'm Ayo Ahmed. This is my independent concept for Trybe. It's unofficial: every guest, booking and payment in this demonstration is synthetic.
scenes.intent: Show Ayo, Unofficial, Independent concept and synthetic disclosure.

scenes.narration: This package combines a treatment, practitioner and room with a shared area session. I review both parts, the time and the total, then hold them together.
scenes.intent: Show components and total, then create a real synthetic all-or-nothing hold.

scenes.narration: Now I advance the fixed simulation clock. The hold expires and every component is released. I request fresh availability before trying again. An expired hold cannot carry old evidence into checkout.
scenes.intent: Advance six minutes; show expired state; request fresh availability and show reviewed fresh snapshot.

scenes.narration: A competing synthetic reservation now takes the last place. My earlier snapshot fails. The alternative shows a different time and total. I accept those changes explicitly, then both package parts are held together.
scenes.intent: Compete, attempt stale snapshot, show explicit difference, accept alternative and display new hold.

scenes.narration: I add synthetic consent and validate the latest evidence. Changing the treatment preference invalidates that check, so I validate again. Only then do I submit the booking and receive its receipt.
scenes.intent: Consent, validate, edit preference, prove invalidation, revalidate and submit.

scenes.narration: Submission isn't settlement. I recover the authoritative receipt, then try fulfilment. It stays blocked while payment is pending. Repeating the same request cannot create another booking, and no real payment is taken.
scenes.intent: Recover receipt; attempt fulfilment and show NOT_SETTLED; display submitted outcome.

scenes.narration: A simulated settlement failure becomes an owned exception. The operator sees a named owner and the next recovery step. I record a synthetic handoff. Nothing is fulfilled, and no external message is sent.
scenes.intent: Fail settlement, show exception owner/next action, record synthetic handoff.

scenes.narration: Finally, I execute the domain checks, inject a broken rule and show the red failure. I export this synthetic session audit. These are test observations, not conversion uplift. I would validate the concept with guests and operators.
scenes.intent: Execute green evaluator, inject red evaluator, export actual synthetic session audit; keep disclosure visible.
